title: Elastic Calderón Problem via Resonant Hard Inclusions: Linearisation of the N-D Map and Density Reconstruction
summary: We study an elastic Calderon-type inverse problem: recover the mass density $ρ(x)$ in a bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^3$ from the Neumann-to-Dirichlet map associated with the isotropic Lamé system $\mathcal{L}_{λ,μ}u+ω^2ρ(x)u=0$. We introduce a constructive strategy that embeds a subwavelength periodic array of resonant high-density (hard) inclusions to create an effective medium with a uniform negative density shift.
